title: Extract common drain logic into shared function in transit/main.rs
description: The ingestion drain task and the staging drain task in crates/transit/src/main.rs each contain ~80 lines of identical logic: build PipelineCtx, call run_pipeline, notify IPNS, enqueue for external pinning. Any change to post-pipeline behavior must be made in both places. Pre-existing issue found during review of stoa-efbe068a. Not introduced by the wildmat epic.
